probes: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'terminal' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.relname, string_agg(a.privilege_type, ',' ORDER BY a.privilege_type) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl, acldefault(CASE WHEN c.relkind = 'S' THEN 's'::"char" ELSE 'r'::"char" END, c.relowner))) a WHERE n.nspname = 'terminal' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND a.grantee = 'terminal_runtime'::regrole GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.relname, CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END, string_agg(a.privilege_type, ',' ORDER BY a.privilege_type) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl, acldefault(CASE WHEN c.relkind = 'S' THEN 's'::"char" ELSE 'r'::"char" END, c.relowner))) a WHERE n.nspname = 'terminal' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'S') AND a.grantee <> c.relowner AND a.grantee <> 'terminal_runtime'::regrole GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END, string_agg(a.privilege_type, ',' ORDER BY a.privilege_type) FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(n.nspacl, acldefault('n', n.nspowner))) a WHERE n.nspname = 'terminal' AND a.grantee <> n.nspowner GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.rolname, m.rolname FROM pg_auth_members a JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = a.roleid JOIN pg_roles m ON m.oid = a.member WHERE r.rolname IN ('terminal_runtime', 'terminal_market_reader') ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT rolname, rolcanlogin, rolsuper OR rolcreaterole OR rolcreatedb OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls, rolconnlimit FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname LIKE 'terminal\_%' ORDER BY 1
SELECT data_type, is_nullable, column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'terminal' AND table_name = 'subscriber' AND column_name = 'kind'
SELECT conname, contype, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'terminal.subscriber'::regclass AND contype <> 'n' ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.attname, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod), a.attnotnull, pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum WHERE a.attrelid = 'terminal.usage_hour'::regclass AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attnum
SELECT conname, contype, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'terminal.usage_hour'::regclass AND contype <> 'n' ORDER BY 1
SELECT indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'terminal' AND tablename = 'usage_hour' ORDER BY 1

SELECT col_description('terminal.subscriber'::regclass, (SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = 'terminal.subscriber'::regclass AND attname = 'kind')) LIKE '%(EXEC-MU-RUNTIME T1).', obj_description('terminal.usage_hour'::regclass, 'pg_class') LIKE '%(EXEC-MU-RUNTIME T1).'

SELECT email, display_name, kind, active, expires_at = timestamptz '2100-01-01 00:00:00+00', password_hash = 'scrypt$' || repeat('0', 32) || '$' || repeat('0', 64), disabled_reason IS NULL FROM terminal.subscriber WHERE email IN ('backtest-worker@terminal.local', 'screener-worker@terminal.local') OR kind = 'service' ORDER BY email

SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'person'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'service') FROM terminal.subscriber WHERE email NOT IN ('backtest-worker@terminal.local', 'screener-worker@terminal.local')
SELECT name, value, unit FROM terminal.quota WHERE name LIKE 'service\_%' ORDER BY 1
SELECT name FROM terminal.quota WHERE name NOT LIKE 'service\_%' ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT subscriber_id FROM terminal.subscriber WHERE email IN ('backtest-worker@terminal.local', 'screener-worker@terminal.local')) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM terminal.quota_override WHERE subscriber_id IN (SELECT subscriber_id FROM s)), (SELECT count(*) FROM terminal.session WHERE subscriber_id IN (SELECT subscriber_id FROM s)), (SELECT count(*) FROM terminal.access_log WHERE subscriber_id IN (SELECT subscriber_id FROM s)), (SELECT count(*) FROM terminal.usage_hour)

SELECT r.role, has_schema_privilege(r.role, 'terminal', 'USAGE'), has_table_privilege(r.role, 'terminal.usage_hour', 'SELECT'), has_table_privilege(r.role, 'terminal.usage_hour', 'INSERT'), has_table_privilege(r.role, 'terminal.usage_hour', 'UPDATE'), has_table_privilege(r.role, 'terminal.usage_hour', 'DELETE'), has_table_privilege(r.role, 'terminal.usage_hour', 'TRUNCATE'), has_table_privilege(r.role, 'terminal.usage_hour', 'REFERENCES'), has_table_privilege(r.role, 'terminal.usage_hour', 'TRIGGER'), has_column_privilege(r.role, 'terminal.subscriber', 'kind', 'SELECT') FROM (VALUES ('terminal_runtime'), ('terminal_api_login'), ('terminal_publisher_login'), ('terminal_market_reader'), ('public')) AS r(role) ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM terminal.quota LIMIT 1) r1), (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT file_count FROM terminal.access_log LIMIT 0) r2), (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT kind FROM terminal.subscriber LIMIT 0) r3), (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT hour_start, grants, files, bytes FROM terminal.usage_hour LIMIT 0) r4)
SELECT email, kind FROM terminal.subscriber WHERE email IN ('backtest-worker@terminal.local', 'screener-worker@terminal.local') AND kind = 'service' AND active AND expires_at > now() ORDER BY email
SELECT count(*) FROM terminal.subscriber WHERE kind = 'person' AND active AND expires_at > now()

SELECT q.name, coalesce(o.value, q.value) AS value FROM terminal.quota q LEFT JOIN terminal.quota_override o ON o.name = q.name AND o.subscriber_id = (SELECT subscriber_id FROM terminal.subscriber WHERE email = 'backtest-worker@terminal.local') WHERE q.name LIKE 'service\_%' ORDER BY 1
SELECT email, kind, active, expires_at > now() AS current FROM terminal.subscriber WHERE email IN ('backtest-worker@terminal.local', 'screener-worker@terminal.local') ORDER BY email
